sources.type: Printing vendor; direct client/design studio interviews and example photographs
sources.visualReviewed: Fos&Co. contact side: compact grouped information and field labels; colored identity side and restrained stock. Browser inspected article hero photo directly.
sources.applied: Contact label/value rows and keeping brand identity distinct from practical details; original layout adapted, no photo/artwork copied.

Animis/Steve Wolf: distinct compact text blocks and a dominant identity element. Both gallery photos opened directly in browser.

decision.scope: Front face only; previous two-sided version preserved
decision.layout: Two-column corporate grid: original logo/company/site left; person/title and M/E contact rows right.
decision.type: Single sans family; name16pt, role7.6pt, contact8.4pt; project design choices, not a claimed industry standard.
decision.color: White background, original gradient logo, brand-ink typography; contact labels use existing logo blue-violet.
decision.artwork: Existing vector SVG reused exactly; no remote visual copied or new logo generated.
decision.print: RGB design proof; CMYK / printing vendor proof not performed.
